title: LRU cache
context: Implement a fixed-size least-recently-used cache for instrument metadata. The doc comment lists the rules; get and put should both be O(1).

points.title: O(1) get and put
points.why: A hash map gives O(1) lookup and a doubly linked list gives O(1) reordering. LinkedHashMap combines both.
points.fix: LinkedHashMap with accessOrder = true, or your own hash map plus doubly linked list.

points.title: Reads count as use
points.why: An LRU cache orders by access, not insertion, so get must move the entry to most recently used.
points.fix: accessOrder = true, or move the node to the head on get.

points.title: Evict only when over capacity
points.why: Evicting on every put, or before an update, removes entries that should stay.
points.fix: removeEldestEntry returning size > capacity, or evict the tail after inserting a new key.

points.title: Validate capacity
points.why: A capacity of 0 or less makes the cache useless and hides a configuration bug.

points.title: Thread safety stated
points.why: LinkedHashMap isn't thread-safe, and with accessOrder even get changes it. Say whether callers must synchronize.
points.fix: Synchronize the methods, or document that the cache is single-threaded (or use Caffeine in production).
